messages.subject: Re: Plant milkweed - Huge discount on seeds! 🦋
messages.text:
I bought your seeds last year planted them and nothing. I was hoping that would be different this year and I see nothing even thinking about coming up. What could have gone wrong? Thank you. Sent from my iPhone

 
 On Apr 4, 2026, at 9:31 AM, Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com> wrote:

 
 ﻿

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hello Suzanne, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Hope you're doing well on this Saturday morning.

 Well, the monarch Spring migration has officially begun! There have been sightings all over Southern USA (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA5X1C0SX99MB1MX0PW9Y5_0): in Texas, California, Georgia and South Carolina. 

 They will fly and fly further North in the next few months until they reach our milkweed plantations around mid-May, where they will breed happily all summer long until they migrate again and we can harvest the precious milkweed silk to make insulated products (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA5X1C0SX99MB1MX0PW9Y5_1) 🦋♥️

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our National Milkweed Planting Campaign is going pretty well too. Thousands of people have already ordered their milkweed seeds to start their monarch butterfly garden.

 
 To encourage even more people to do so, we are pleased to offer discounts of 40 to 50% on milkweed seeds for a few days only. Hurry, it won't last long! 👇 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Buy milkweed seeds, start a butterfly garden (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA5X1C0SX99MB1MX0PW9Y5_2)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 If the button doesn't work, here is the link: https://lasclay.com/en-us/collections/garden (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA5X1C0SX99MB1MX0PW9Y5_3)​ (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KNCA5X1C0SX99MB1MX0PW9Y5_4) 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Thank you so much Suzanne , and Happy Easter! 🐣🐰 

 Warmly,

 Gabriel 
Founder
Lasclay

messages.text:
Hello Suzanne, 
 

 We are truly sorry to hear that the germination of your milkweed seeds did not meet your expectations.
 

 Milkweed is especially close to our hearts, it plays a vital role in biodiversity, and we truly care about seeing it thrive in each of our customers’ gardens. 
 

 With this in mind, we will arrange a replacement for your order. We sincerely hope this new attempt will allow you to fully enjoy the beauty and benefits of milkweed.
 

 Please don’t hesitate to keep us updated, it would be a real pleasure to hear how it goes.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
